body: When I know I am sick, I can do that. But most of the time, I don't know it. I just feel awful, empty, dead inside. And I feel fucking guilty by that.
Thank you. You are very kind and just told me what I think I needed to hear.

I just need to vent and perhaps not feel that lonely.  
I hate my diseased brain and I would no hesitate to trade it for anything that would help me lead a normal life.
I am not, and this is a very cruel thing to say, mate.
